primary_anchor_zh: 穹顶开口下的大望远镜、侧墙控制台和控制台旁高凳所构成的整体布局
story_reason_zh: 金属观测门为短暂隔离外侧平台而缓慢关闭，随后重新打开

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 整间天文台在蓝调暮色的天文台穹顶室，保持安静稳定，仅开口外天空缓慢变暗。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持安静稳定，仅开口外天空缓慢变暗
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 穹顶开口下的大望远镜、侧墙控制台和控制台旁高凳所构成的整体布局占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 宽大的金属观测门缓慢关闭并遮住穹顶室，画面只留下观测平台
shot_design.main_action_zh: 宽大的金属观测门缓慢关闭并遮住穹顶室，画面只留下观测平台
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 门、屏风或入口帘的开合符合场景用途，动作缓慢，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 天文台外侧的空观测平台

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 金属观测门缓慢打开，重新露出完整天文台布局
shot_design.main_action_zh: 金属观测门缓慢打开，重新露出完整天文台布局
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示穹顶开口下的大望远镜、侧墙控制台和控制台旁高凳所构成的整体布局，以整体空间关系作为唯一验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a large telescope beneath the dome opening, a control console along the side wall, and a high stool beside the console inside an observatory at blue hour. The sky beyond the dome opening deepens gradually.

A fixed wide shot looks through an open entrance onto a large telescope beneath the dome opening, a control console along the side wall, and a high stool beside the console inside an observatory at blue hour. A broad metal observation door slowly closes across the entrance until the room is fully hidden, leaving only the empty observation platform in view.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty observation platform. A broad metal observation door slowly opens, revealing a large telescope beneath the dome opening, a control console along the side wall, and a high stool beside the console inside an observatory at blue hour.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 宽大的金属观测门缓慢关闭并遮住穹顶室，画面只留下观测平台
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 天文台外侧的空观测平台
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 金属观测门缓慢打开，重新露出完整天文台布局
transition_design.design_note_zh: Scene/layout 无法自行离场，因此 Shot 2 用自然遮挡结构缓慢关闭，Shot 3 用对应开启动作重新露出整体布局。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
